description:
Upload the audio file `holiday_greeting_2026.wav` (located in `~/Documents/`) to the Vicidial Audio Store. Then, navigate to the Call Menus section and update the `MAIN_IVR` (Main Inbound Menu) to use this new audio file as its Menu Prompt.

**IMPORTANT:** When setting the Menu Prompt field in the Call Menu settings, enter ONLY the filename (e.g., `holiday_greeting_2026`) WITHOUT the `.wav` extension. The system automatically appends the extension based on the audio format.
